description: Spec 036 Teil 5 ③: copy of valid/dokumentaro-plena whose butono still holds the placeholder in when-not and describes Enter but not Space, a key its Skemo names. A placeholder is valid for the schema – every Ero carries the field before its text is written – but the documentation is not done until the text stands, so check:dokumentaro reports it like a missing field; a key the element answers to without a word on what it does leaves the keyboard table incomplete.
